title: Jemma J
content: I was as a single mom with severe vertigo, anxiety, and PTSD. I was suffering from three panic attacks a day. My quality of life was almost nonexistent. My experience completely changed my life. I found surrender and peace; and I let go. I felt expansive, connected, and whole. I did not want to come back, but I had a very clear vision of my daughter begging me to return. That is the only reason for me coming back because my daughter needed me. Since then, I have channeled many messages from the place I visited. I remember very specific messages I needed to share from there. I am writing a book to document what I learned.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Allergic Reaction, Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function)
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I was expanded and whole. I was also the observer.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I fully let go just after I genuinely thought I was going to die.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, Time slowed and lost its meaning. Time on earth was an illusion.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: It was more a feeling; I felt at total peace after 20 solid years of pain and worry.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I was not aware of hearing during the experience, but I did hear the nurse call my next of kin just before the experience started.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain, It was more like I expanded higher out of my body and came to a door.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, My brother, who was alive at the time but has now passed on.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, Everything was brighter, and there was white light all over.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, It was a land with wonderful big trees and temples for me to experience and learn in.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about myself or others, I learned why I had had so much anxiety on earth.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: I witnessed myself before this life, creating all the specific experiences I needed, calling them in. I also reviewed and processed my childhood trauma.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life, I had a very clear vision of my seven-year-old daughter asking me to come back, even though I didn't want to.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Other faiths- New age, I have traveled the world and studied many faiths. Shaman and spiritual are the religions I relate with most.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, I am more spiritual and go to church every week now.
elements.What is your religion now?: Other or several faiths, Spiritual, shaman
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I was riddled with fears and anxiety. I was tightened up like a coil and was shown how to untether myself.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I value my time more. I quit my high-paying, super stressful job and changed my life completely in every way possible.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, It was my brother's voice, but I didn't realize it at the time. He was alive then; he died in 2023, but now I am able to go back and recognize him as my guide when I was there.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, That it does exist and that it is the reason for us being here.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, I was awakened and aware of much more than I thought was possible.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, To learn, to evolve, to practice, and to awaken.
Yes, I was told very clearly that life is a type of simulation and the truth is much bigger. I was taught all about it.
Yes, That it is all an illusion and the trick is to wake up to it and become the neutral observer.
Yes, It's who we are at our core and we are infinitely loved.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, My relationship with my daughter is 100% better. She was and is the most important person in the world to me. Prior, I was unable to be present for her because I was riddled with so much anxiety. She was about seven at the time.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, It was overwhelming and hard to put into words.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, I am able to go back and communicate with my brother.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The part where I saw myself plan this life. The people who were the meanest to me on earth were actually my friends and allies.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, It was very vivid and completely changed my life.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I am certain it was real and again was the catalyst for changing my life. I got my life back.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes, When I write about my experience, I understand more and more about it. It feels like by writing, it is taking me back there.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Uncertain, Again, too much to tell. It would be better to explain in person.
